args: Analyze the root cause and safest minimal fix for the tracing-JIT stale stack/refcount state vulnerability in php-src/ext/opcache/jit/zend_jit_trace.c involving the two-opcode ZEND_ASSIGN_DIM / ZEND_OP_DATA sequence, indirect globals, and warning callbacks that mutate aliases. Identify exact functions/branches and any analogous invalidation logic for other opcodes that should be mirrored.

The supplied reproducer is `<?set_error_handler(function(){$GLOBALS['a']='';})[]=$a[$\xff]='';` under the tracing-JIT fuzz harness. A warning during nested dimension evaluation invokes the Closure and reassigns aliased global `a`; the trace preserves a stale temporary/indirect stack value through ASSIGN_DIM/OP_DATA. On side exit, `ZEND_ASSIGN_DIM_SPEC_VAR_UNUSED_OP_DATA_TMP_HANDLER` destroys the stale array, releasing the error-handler Closure while EG(user_error_handler) still points at it, leading to shutdown UAF. The report explicitly identifies missing callback/alias invalidation in zend_jit_trace.c rather than the VM destructor. I have not edited anything yet and need the exact trace-state handling and a root-cause patch, preferably aligned with existing callback/clobber handling.
